name: Highly Casual | 50mg Iced Tea | Lemonade
description: A refreshing, crushable twist on the classic Arnold Palmer – we infused ours with THC! This lemonade forward bevy will be sure improve your golf swing with a hangover free buzz either actually or mentally! With a hint of tea, this is sure to hit the sweet spot of nostalgia you're seeking with the classic pairing of Lemonade and Iced Tea. Big flavor, bigger chill and packing a serious 50mg of premium Nano THC. It’s the taste of Nostalgia, with the kind of buzz you only get as an adult. Sip it slow, or don’t — either way, it’s gonna hit.
